newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Thermedics gets strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Thermedics gets strong buy.

text.p: Barrington Research Associates Inc said it began coverage of Thermedics Detection Inc with a strong buy rating.
-- Thermedics, which went public in March 1997, makes high-speed measurement and detection equipment used in industrial processes, explosives detection and laboratory analysis.

-- Thermedics reported 1997 second quarter earnings at the high end of estimates on a 23 percent increase in revenues. Next year's earnings are expected to to show a 40 percent gain, Barrington analyst Michael Hutchison said in a report.
-- Shares of Thermedics were trading at 11-11/6, unchanged from yesterday's close.
